text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 10, "unit": "packets", "kind": "count", "span": "ten packets of crayons"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 6, "unit": "packets", "kind": "count", "span": "Six of the packets"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 8, "unit": "pieces", "kind": "count", "span": "eight pieces of colors each"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 4, "unit": "packets", "kind": "count", "span": "the other four packets"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 16, "unit": "pieces", "kind": "count", "span": "sixteen pieces of colors each"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "6 packets * 8 pieces = 48"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q4", "q5"], "out": "s2", "note": "4 packets * 16 pieces = 64"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "48 + 64 = 112 total colors"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "total number of crayon colors Beatrice bought in all"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 10, "reason": "total packet count (6+4=10) already implied by the two packet groups; not needed separately"}]}
